data.name: Deadly Cryptids
data.detailed_description:
Deadly Cryptids... that physically intense VR action shooter that gets your heart racing.

Explore a mysterious ruin that seems oddly out of place, as you and your partner Kate are lost in the desert after your plane crashed. Face evil monsters and blow them all to bits.

Use your body to take cover and survive action-packed scenes. Tap into your best shooting skills and use real weapons to kill a legion of deadly cryptids. Throw grenades & Molotov cocktails, slash your combat knives and dual wield your way to survival. When the action gets too intense, jam an adrenaline needle in your chest to slow down time and destroy all that is evil.

Sharpen your shooting skills in the Shooting Range. Check the monitors for the bullet impacts on the targets and adjust your aim accordingly.
Perform cool and satisfying reload tricks that make every reload something you look forward to.

Can you physically handle the intensity? Put your VR headset on and discover how you really react in simulated combat situations.

STORY:
After your plane crashed in the desert, you and your partner Kate have been wandering the desert for days in order to survive. You wake up at a mysterious ruin that seems oddly out of place. It does not take long before you realize this place is full of danger.

KEY FEATURES:
- Full fledged campaign: enjoy a thrilling VR ride with more than 4 hours of fun
- Intuitive cover system: experience being under heavy fire while physically taking cover by ducking, hiding, dodging and even laying on the ground
- Slow motion killfest: slow down time and experience the incredibly cool adrenaline simulating kill-them-all-or-die-trying feature
- Wield a devastating arsenal of 11 weapons including Beretta, Magnum 44, AK-47, Scar, Shotgun, grenades,... even the ever powerful Mini gun
- Realistic weapon handling: wanna go pro? Choose manual reload to change clips, pull out pins and shotgun shells in order to survive
- Reload Tricks make every reload something you look forward to
- Shooting Range: sharpen your aim at the Shooting Range.

This is Deadly Cryptids... designed to be intense.

reviews.review:
Deadly Cryptids is a physically demanding virtual reality action shooter that blends monster hunting, survival horror, and arcade-style combat into an energetic adventure. Developed and published by Flow VR, the game focuses on making players feel directly involved in dangerous encounters through motion-controlled weapons, physical cover mechanics, and intense firefights. Rather than relying on complicated systems or elaborate storytelling, it emphasizes fast reactions, accurate shooting, and bodily movement. Its free-to-play availability makes it an accessible option for VR enthusiasts who already possess compatible equipment, although its demanding mechanics and relatively modest production values may not appeal to everyone.

The adventure follows a survivor and their companion Kate after a plane crash leaves them stranded in a remote desert. Following several days of struggling through the wilderness, they encounter mysterious ruins that conceal a horrifying collection of hostile creatures. What begins as a desperate search for safety quickly develops into a violent struggle against supernatural threats. The setting provides a suitable foundation for an action-oriented horror experience, combining isolation, uncertainty, and dangerous environments. However, the narrative primarily serves as motivation for combat rather than offering substantial character development or an intricate mystery. Players interested in atmospheric exploration may appreciate the premise, but those expecting a deeply developed storyline could find the storytelling somewhat limited.

The most distinctive aspect of the gameplay is its commitment to physical immersion. Surviving enemy attacks requires more than simply moving a character behind cover with a controller. Players must actively crouch, dodge, lean, hide, and sometimes lower themselves toward the ground to avoid incoming danger. This approach makes firefights feel considerably more personal, as defensive movements depend on the player's actual reactions. The resulting encounters can create genuine excitement, particularly when enemies attack from multiple directions. However, the constant physical activity can also become exhausting, making the experience better suited to players comfortable with standing or room-scale VR gameplay.

Combat benefits from an arsenal of eleven weapons, including recognizable firearms such as the Beretta, Magnum .44, AK-47, SCAR, shotguns, and a powerful minigun. Grenades, Molotov cocktails, and combat knives introduce additional methods of eliminating enemies, while dual-wielding allows players to embrace a more aggressive fighting style. The variety encourages experimentation with different offensive approaches, from carefully aimed shots to overwhelming firepower. One particularly interesting feature is the optional manual reloading system, which requires players to manipulate magazines, ammunition, and weapon components. Reload tricks further emphasize the physical nature of combat, turning an ordinary shooting mechanic into something more interactive and entertaining.

Another memorable feature is the adrenaline mechanic, which allows players to slow down time by physically injecting their character with a stimulant. This ability transforms chaotic encounters into cinematic action sequences, providing additional opportunities to eliminate dangerous enemies while avoiding attacks. The mechanic complements the game's aggressive combat philosophy and offers a welcome alternative to ordinary firefights. Its exaggerated presentation fits the arcade-inspired atmosphere, although the overall experience remains focused on straightforward shooting rather than complex tactical encounters. The dedicated shooting range is also a useful addition, allowing players to practice accuracy, examine bullet impacts through monitoring equipment, and become familiar with the available firearms before entering more demanding situations.

The game's presentation combines mysterious ruins, monstrous enemies, and violent confrontations to establish an unsettling atmosphere. Its horror elements rely more heavily on threatening creatures and immediate physical danger than on psychological suspense. This distinction is important because the experience behaves more like an action shooter with horror themes than a traditional survival horror adventure. The environments support the central premise, but the relatively limited scope means players should not expect the visual sophistication, environmental complexity, or cinematic storytelling associated with larger productions. Nevertheless, the combination of immersive combat and supernatural enemies provides a recognizable identity that helps distinguish the experience from ordinary target-shooting simulations.

In terms of content, the advertised campaign offers more than four hours of gameplay, which is a respectable amount for a free VR shooter. Its greatest appeal comes from mastering weapon handling, experimenting with different firearms, and responding physically to increasingly dangerous situations. However, the combat-focused structure may become repetitive for players who prefer substantial exploration, meaningful progression systems, or greater mission variety. The game also demands considerable physical participation, which could discourage players looking for a relaxed experience. Despite these limitations, its combination of shooting mechanics, interactive reloading, and dramatic slow-motion combat provides enough variety to make the central concept worthwhile.

Steam Deck compatibility is another important consideration. Deadly Cryptids does not have a confirmed Steam Deck Verified or Playable designation, and its VR-only design makes it unsuitable for normal handheld gameplay. The game requires SteamVR-compatible hardware and tracked motion controllers, with standing or room-scale movement forming an essential part of its mechanics. Consequently, it cannot be recommended as a conventional Steam Deck experience. Players interested in trying it should instead use an appropriately equipped VR gaming computer.

Overall, Deadly Cryptids offers an entertaining interpretation of virtual reality shooting by emphasizing physical movement, weapon interaction, and relentless monster combat. Its strongest qualities are its immersive cover system, varied arsenal, manual reloading mechanics, and entertaining adrenaline ability. Although the limited storytelling, potentially repetitive encounters, and demanding hardware requirements restrict its wider appeal, the game remains an interesting option for enthusiasts seeking straightforward VR action. It does not reinvent the genre, but its willingness to prioritize physical engagement gives it a personality of its own. Considering its free-to-play nature and the amount of content advertised, it is worth exploring for players who enjoy intense, movement-driven virtual reality experiences.

A satisfying and physically engaging VR shooter with enjoyable weapon mechanics and energetic monster encounters, although its repetitive combat structure, modest narrative, and VR-only accessibility prevent it from reaching greater heights.


Rating: 7/10
